name: glob
description: Find files by glob pattern. Supports * (non-separator), ** (any depth), ? (single char), [abc] (char class). Returns a sorted list of matching file paths. Skips node_modules/.git/dist/build by default.

pattern.description: Glob pattern, e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.json", "*.md". Use "/" as path separator.

path.description: Root directory to search in (default: agent working directory). Absolute or relative to cwd.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 200, max 1000).
